skills.problem: Weak generic repository/path token overlap can be mistaken for meaningful historical evidence and fabricate a risk signal for an unrelated subsystem.
skills.prevention_rule: Ignore generic structural path/repository tokens and require either an explicit path match or at least one informative matched token before verified history contributes to the risk profile.
skills.residual_risk: Future repository layouts may introduce new generic tokens; explicit path matches and fail-closed NO_RELEVANT_VERIFIED_HISTORY behavior remain the safety boundary.

skills.problem: Model-facing Research Report instructions can describe a correct evidence boundary while structurally valid model output still violates that boundary unless the parser independently enforces it.
skills.prevention_rule: For Research Report evidence and provenance changes, mirror every model-facing evidence-boundary rule with a deterministic fail-closed validator over known EvidenceRecord identities/directness and a regression test; prompt compliance is never authority.
skills.residual_risk: Structural validators cannot establish final scientific semantics, readability, or Monster golden-case Product Reality; those remain separate evidence and acceptance gates.
